stage_acquisition_plan.name: Câmara anódica
stage_acquisition_plan.acquisition_and_comparability_requiremen: Chamber dimensions, wetted material, chemical compatibility/leachables, usable volume and seals; product-specific cost still pending.

stage_acquisition_plan.name: Meio anódico
stage_acquisition_plan.acquisition_and_comparability_requiremen: Reagent identity/hydration, stock recipe, COD vs calculated BOD, conductivity/pH and replacement history; no cost assigned from a generic chemical name.

stage_acquisition_plan.name: Ânodo
stage_acquisition_plan.acquisition_and_comparability_requiremen: Felt/paper/cloth grade, activation, directional resistivity, wetting, mounted geometry and lot identity; matched wet characterization still pending.

stage_acquisition_plan.name: Catalisador anódico
stage_acquisition_plan.acquisition_and_comparability_requiremen: No added artificial catalyst in initial family; preserve not-applicable until a separately characterized coating is documented.

stage_acquisition_plan.name: Biofilme
stage_acquisition_plan.acquisition_and_comparability_requiremen: Inoculum/enrichment, maturation and medium-switch history are controls/confounders, not coefficients inferred from material BET.

stage_acquisition_plan.name: Membrana
stage_acquisition_plan.acquisition_and_comparability_requiremen: Membrane grade, counterion, prehydration, ASR/selectivity and electrolyte; current no-membrane kernel remains out of scope for membrane predictions.

stage_acquisition_plan.name: Circuito e alimentação/coleta
stage_acquisition_plan.acquisition_and_comparability_requiremen: External resistance and sampling, collector identity/contact geometry and feed/collection regime; contact losses require their own evidence.

stage_acquisition_plan.name: Câmara catódica
stage_acquisition_plan.acquisition_and_comparability_requiremen: Air-side aperture/seals/chamber exposure; do not add an independent liquid reservoir for air cathodes.

stage_acquisition_plan.name: Meio catódico
stage_acquisition_plan.acquisition_and_comparability_requiremen: Shared anolyte or ambient gas boundary as topology requires; no infinite controlled-gas reservoir and no invented catholyte volume.

stage_acquisition_plan.name: Cátodo
stage_acquisition_plan.acquisition_and_comparability_requiremen: Separate bare support, MPL, hydrophobic treatment and completeGDE; compare within matched assembly/operating conditions.

stage_acquisition_plan.name: Catalisador catódico
stage_acquisition_plan.acquisition_and_comparability_requiremen: Separate metal loading, support mass fraction and ionomer/binder; cost of bare support is not finished catalyst assembly cost.
